items.title: 混淆应保护你自己的业务逻辑，而不是周边第三方代码
items.title_orig: Protect the module that holds your logic, not the vendor code around it
items.summary: 把整个生产包交给混淆器会浪费运行时和体积预算，去保护React、日期库等公开可下载的代码。
items.summary_orig: When teams first add an obfuscator, the default move is to feed it the entire production bundle. It feels thorough. In practice it often means you spend most of your runtime and file-size budget protecting React, a date library, and a polyfill that anyone can download from npm in readable form.

items.title: 混淆前先扫描包中的密钥：混淆不能让泄露的密钥变安全
items.title_orig: Scan your bundle for secrets before you obfuscate it: obfuscation will not make a leaked key safe
items.summary: 混淆只提高理解代码的成本，密钥无需被理解就能被滥用，运行中的页面终究会把它交给网络。
items.summary_orig: There is a tempting line of reasoning in front-end teams: "The key is in the bundle, but we obfuscate the bundle, so it's fine." It isn't. Obfuscation raises the cost of understanding code. A secret does not need to be understood to be abused. It only needs to be found once, and the running page will eventually hand it to the network anyway.

items.title: AI 智能体重试调用导致重复扣款，如何防止？
items.title_orig: My AI agent retried a call and paid twice. How do I prevent it?
items.summary: 这属于响应丢失问题：调用已执行但回包丢失，简单重试会再次产生付费操作。
items.summary_orig: The short answer Your agent did not misbehave. It hit the lost-response problem: a call executes, the response is lost in transit, and from the agent's side the world looks identical whether the work happened or not. A naive retry then re-executes, and a paid effect happens twice.

items.title: 如何判断AI智能体的工作是真实还是伪造
items.title_orig: How do I know if an AI agent's work is real or faked?
items.summary: 仅看工作产物或智能体摘要都无法判断，伪造通常表现为调用未执行、执行了不同调用或结果事后被修改。
items.summary_orig: The short answer You cannot tell from the work product alone, and you cannot tell from the agent's summary at all. Faked agent work fails in three specific ways: the call never ran, a different call ran than the one reported, or the result was edited after the fact.

items.summary_orig: We usually picture mountain building as rock being pushed upward. For the first time, astronomers got to observe one of these in real time.

items.title_orig: Show HN: PocketOps for SigNoz: The Open Source Datadog Alternative
items.summary: 作者把可观测性栈从 DataDog 迁到自托管 SigNoz 以保留加拿大数据驻留，因网页端不响应式而做了这个移动应用。
